title: Skald Template Roll Macros
description: Roll macros owned by a Character Sheet Template Version (the `macros` key of a template source, ADR 0011). Body restrictions (no field writes, allow-listed dice notation and functions, resolved references) are enforced by the publish validator.

propertyNames.description: Macro id, the form a {{#id[...]}} reference can spell (not __proto__/constructor/prototype)

params.description: Ordered parameter declarations, referenced inside the body as @name

default.description: Formula-string default used when the call omits this argument. Evaluated in the caller's context: it can read numeric template fields, not parameters or roll results

body.description: Macro body: if/elif/else, roll("...") and return. Field writes (:=) are not allowed in a template macro. Every if needs a final else; rolled/total are readable after a roll, target/margin after a roll with a comparison. Length and roll limits are enforced by the publish validator.
